display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-03 Data-driven circular economy for e-mobility ecosystem (2ZERO Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-03 Data-driven circular economy for e-mobility ecosystem (2ZERO Partnership)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Innovation Action under the 2ZERO partnership (Towards zero emission road transport) that funds better circularity of electric-vehicle drivetrain components and EV charging infrastructure (area A: design for long life, repair, refurbishment and dismantling, with health and remaining-useful-life monitoring) and data-driven life-cycle management of electric vehicles (area B: track-and-trace concepts, real-world load measurement, open data interfaces and digital-twin-based product passports), up to TRL 6–7. Open to consortia under the standard Horizon Europe rules, excluding entities controlled from China; funded as a lump sum at Innovation Action rates (70% for for-profit entities, 100% for non-profit). Indicative topic budget EUR 24 million, EUR 5–7 million per project for about four projects, with at least the two best proposals per area funded. Planned opening 15 December 2026; single-stage deadline 14 April 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 8 (Climate, Energy and Mobility), pp. 217–221, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-03, funds circular design, health monitoring and product passports for electric-vehicle drivetrain components and EV charging infrastructure. It does not touch TenneT's field: the work concerns vehicle components and charging equipment within the road-transport value chain, with no grid, transmission or system-operation element; Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) shares only the idea of condition-based remaining-useful-life assessment, applied here to vehicle parts. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
